June 10, 2017 - MOSCOW

The Russian Press were snapping many picture of the Putin Family, his twin boys, Vladimir and Alexander and The Prime Minister of Norway. Smiles were on the faces of the adults, although the twins weren't very receptive to the foreign leader.

"Beautiful boys" he said "I only hope I can improve relations with them, Alexander especially, he really didn't like me" He said to a room full of laughs.

"I hope, nay, I know these boys will be great men, much like their father. Anyone willing to help people in need, as he showed during the Oslo III accords, has my respect."

"We were willing to fill the void of aid left by China, but the help of the Norwegian and South Korean people is greatly appreciated. Russia helps its allies, no matter what." Putin said.

After the first day of celebrations and photo ops, work began right away between the Russian and the Norwegian delegates, including the Prime Minister himself. Prime Minister Daylom announced that the Norwegian embassy in the Arbat district of Moscow would be undergoing a 2.3 million (USD) dollar renovation. "We want this to be a place that Russian diplomats feel welcomed, and WANT to come to". "I said on the day of my election that I intended to improve relations with the Kremlin, and that's exactly what I'm doing. I am a man of my word"

No details have been released about the talks, but political insiders speculate that the PM of Norway brought up the Ukrainian conflict, ongoing aid to North Korea and the possibility of a Northern Eurasian energy bloc.

This diplomatic visit by the Prime Minister has not only Putin but also the Russian people's high reverence. Norway is now seen quite favorably by the Russian people and hope that this will be the mark of a new era with close diplomatic relations between the two countries.
